full_judgment: "3. Eviction of outgoing lessee from land or building-If on the expiry, whether before or after the commencement of this ordinance, of the period of a lease in respect of any land or building of which the provincial Government or a Local Authority is the lessor or on the determination of such lease or the ground of breach of any covenant or on the determination of such lease according to the terms and conditions of the lease or otherwise, the lessee refused or failed, or refuses or fails to vacate that land or building and put the lessor into possession of the same, then notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force or in any contract, it shall be lawful for the Deputy Commissioner, on his own motion or on the complaint of or upon information received from anybody or a Local Authority, at any time after the expiry or determination of the lease, to re-enter upon the demised land or building and recover khas possession thereof by evicting the lessee and by demolishing and removing structures, if any, erected or built thereon by the lessee."
